text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature brilliantly managed
to leave her mark on the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those
truly precious "first three years"—

And so, one day while still basking in the afterglow
of that major milestone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Uryaaa--h!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haaah...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, 3rd place again!
They pulled away at the very end!

As part of her training,
Nice Nature ran a few practice heats.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that charge down the final stretch was incredible!
Man, you really had me sweating!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Still...
Nature-san is as impressive as ever.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hm? What about it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In that 3,000m just now, as well as the 2,000m earlier,
you've consistently secured 3rd place.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Distance, track condition, racecourse—none of it matters to you.
That is proof of your sheer inherent strength.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, you know it!
After all, that's my signature style!
After Mejiro McQueen and the others left...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we continue training?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, from before?
Well, I suppose so~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"3rd place is my trademark"... Ahaha,
I never would've said something like that in the past.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Because now, I truly believe
that this too is part of who I am.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I've realized this "do it when I feel like it"
position is actually pretty comfy.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer...
don't get your hopes up too high, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Because it makes me want to step up for them!
